title: PuzzleBench: A Fully Dynamic Evaluation Framework for Large Multimodal Models on Puzzle Solving

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing model accuracy on multiple-choice tasks under a 'Fixed Option' setting (where the correct answer is consistently placed, e.g., option B) versus a 'Randomized Option' setting (where correct answers are randomly shuffled) to determine if models rely on learned positional cues rather than genuine reasoning.
